name: SentinelX Core MCP
description: An MCP server that proxies tool calls to a running SentinelX Core instance with OIDC/OAuth authentication. It enables secure integration of SentinelX Core's HTTP agent capabilities through the MCP protocol.

rawRecord.description: An MCP server that proxies tool calls to a running SentinelX Core instance with OIDC/OAuth authentication. It enables secure integration of SentinelX Core's HTTP agent capabilities through the MCP protocol.

MCP_PORT.description: The port for the MCP server to listen on (e.g., 8098 or 8099).

MCP_TOKEN.description: Optional token for MCP server authentication.

AUTH_DEBUG.description: Enable debug logging for authentication (e.g., false).

OIDC_ISSUER.description: The OIDC issuer URL for validating external MCP bearer tokens (e.g., https://auth.example.com/realms/sentinelx).

RESOURCE_URL.description: The resource URL for the MCP server (e.g., https://sentinelx.example.com).

OIDC_JWKS_URI.description: The JWKS URI for OIDC token validation (e.g., https://auth.example.com/realms/sentinelx/protocol/openid-connect/certs).

SENTINELX_URL.description: The URL of the upstream SentinelX Core instance (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:8091).

SENTINELX_TOKEN.description: The bearer token for authenticating with the upstream SentinelX Core API.

OIDC_EXPECTED_AUDIENCE.description: Optional expected audience for OIDC token validation.
